editorial.blurb: El Che is a warm, modern steakhouse where expertly cooked beef and pristine seafood shine alongside attentive service that makes every occasion feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server about the tasting menu option ("leap of faith") for a curated multi-course journey, and request the house-made shoestring fries on the side to keep their crispy texture intact.

topDishes.note: Pristine lobster tails, head-on prawns, scallops, and oysters in perfect shellfish butter
Creatively plated in a ceramic marrow bone with perfectly textured bread
Beautifully tender with signature smoky char and complementary sauces
